title_sq: 🌆Kombinim i jetës urbane me qetësinë klasike – shitet apartament 2+1 pranë Mozaikut!

title_en: 🌆Combination of urban life with classic tranquility - 2+1 apartment for sale near Mozaik!
description_en: ▶Offered for sale is an apartment with regular layout and natural lighting, located near one of the historical areas of the city, with quick access to the center of Tirana.
